groups.title: Discover what this server can do

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.title: Get server capabilities
tools.summary: Start here. Returns what this ReelForge server can do right now: installed engines (and whether each can render on this machine), templates, themes, media providers (configured...

tools.name: get_project_schema
tools.title: Get the project manifest JSON Schema
tools.summary: Returns the JSON Schema of the project manifest (current schemaVersion).

tools.name: list_templates
tools.title: List scene templates
tools.summary: Lists scene templates with their engine, description, supported duration range in seconds, the theme tokens they read, and the JSON Schema of their props.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.title: List themes
tools.summary: Lists brand themes (built-in "default" and "midnight" plus custom ones) with their tokens: colours, font family, heading weight, motion speed, caption style.

tools.name: get_theme
tools.title: Get a theme
tools.summary: Returns one theme (built-in or custom) with all its tokens: colours, font, weights, motion speed, caption style.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.title: List media providers
tools.summary: Media providers (TTS, ...) installed on this server, whether the operator configured them, and their cost notes.

tools.name: create_project
tools.title: Create a project
tools.summary: Creates a project from a manifest.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.summary: Lists projects on this server with title, version, scene count and duration.

tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.summary: Returns the current manifest, its version number and the computed timing of every scene (start frame, duration in frames and seconds).

tools.name: update_project
tools.title: Update a project
tools.summary: Changes a project. Give either patch (a JSON merge patch, RFC 7396: objects merge, null deletes a key, arrays replace) or manifest (a full replacement).

tools.name: delete_project
tools.title: Delete a project
tools.summary: Deletes a project with all its versions and renders.

tools.name: list_project_versions
tools.title: List saved versions of a project
tools.summary: Every update saves a new version.

tools.name: add_scene
tools.title: Add a scene
tools.summary: Adds a scene at index (default: the end).

tools.name: update_scene
tools.title: Update a scene
tools.summary: Changes one scene with a JSON merge patch, e.g. { "props": { "headline": "New" } } or { "durationSeconds": 4 }.

tools.name: remove_scene
tools.title: Remove a scene
tools.summary: Removes one scene (a project keeps at least one).

tools.name: reorder_scenes
tools.title: Reorder scenes
tools.summary: Sets the scene order. order must list every scene id exactly once.

tools.name: validate_project
tools.title: Validate a project
tools.summary: Full validation report: errors (block rendering) and warnings (e.g. missing licence, rounding of durationSeconds, captions not rendered yet), plus a summary (scenes, total frame...

tools.name: set_theme
tools.title: Set the project theme
tools.summary: Sets the theme: a theme id (see list_themes) or inline tokens on top of a base theme, e.g. { "base": "midnight", "tokens": { "colors": { "accent": "#ff8800" } } }.

tools.name: create_theme
tools.title: Create a theme
tools.summary: Creates a reusable brand theme. tokens needs colors {background, surface, text, mutedText, accent, accent2} as #rrggbb and fontFamily (a CSS font-family list); optional headingW...

tools.name: update_theme
tools.title: Replace a custom theme
tools.summary: Replaces a custom theme (built-in themes cannot be changed).

tools.name: delete_theme
tools.title: Delete a custom theme
tools.summary: Deletes a custom theme. Projects that use it fail validation until they pick another theme.

tools.name: set_audio
tools.title: Set music, voice and sound effects
tools.summary: Merges into the project audio: { music: { asset, volume 0..1, fadeOutSeconds }, voice: { asset, volume, startFrame }, sfx: [{ asset, atFrame, volume }] }.

tools.name: add_asset_from_url
tools.title: Import an asset from a URL
tools.summary: Downloads an image, audio, video or font from a public https URL into the server asset store (size-limited, private networks refused, type checked from the bytes) and, with proj...

tools.name: upload_asset
tools.title: Upload an asset (base64)
tools.summary: Uploads a small file you already have (image, audio, video, font) as base64, for example generated audio.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.title: List assets
tools.summary: Lists assets: those of a project (manifest entries) with projectId, otherwise everything in the server asset store.

tools.name: get_asset
tools.title: Get an asset
tools.summary: Metadata of an asset in the store: content type, media type, size, sha256, source, licence, provider metadata (e.g. TTS word timestamps).

tools.name: generate_voice
tools.title: Generate a voice-over (TTS provider)
tools.summary: Creates a voice-over audio asset with a configured TTS provider (e.g. "elevenlabs") and returns word timestamps.

tools.name: run_provider
tools.title: Run a media provider
tools.summary: Runs any configured provider with its own parameters (see list_providers) and stores the result as an asset.

tools.name: preview_scene
tools.title: Render a quick preview
tools.summary: Starts a low-resolution preview render (default 1/3 size) of one scene, or of the whole project when sceneId is omitted.

tools.name: render_project
tools.title: Render the project
tools.summary: Validates the project and starts the final render (every scene with its engine, assembled with audio, checked with ffprobe and a full decode).

tools.name: get_job
tools.title: Get job status
tools.summary: Status of a render/preview job: queued, running (with progress stage and fraction), succeeded (result has renderId and output URLs), failed (error with code and stage) or cancel...

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.summary: Lists render and preview jobs (newest first), optionally only those of one project.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.title: Cancel a job
tools.summary: Cancels a queued or running job.

tools.name: retry_job
tools.title: Retry a failed or cancelled job
tools.summary: Starts a new job with the same parameters as a failed or cancelled one (same project version).

tools.name: get_job_logs
tools.title: Get job logs
tools.summary: Log lines of a job (use when a job failed to see the failing stage and tool output).

tools.name: get_render_output
tools.title: Get a render output
tools.summary: Returns the output of a finished render: downloadUrl (a signed link to the MP4 that works WITHOUT a key until downloadUrlExpiresAt, about 1 hour; give this to the user or to cur...

tools.name: list_renders
tools.title: List renders of a project
tools.summary: Lists finished renders and previews of a project, newest first, with output URLs, size, fps, frames and duration.

tools.name: configure_provider
tools.title: Configure a media provider (admin)
tools.summary: Sets or clears a provider setting such as ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (see list_providers for each provider's setting names).

tools.name: get_config
tools.title: Get the server configuration (admin)
tools.summary: Returns every server setting with its effective value and where it comes from: source "default", "file" (REELFORGE_CONFIG), "env" (origin names the variable) or "runtime" (set w...

tools.name: update_config
tools.title: Change runtime settings (admin)
tools.summary: Changes runtime settings at once and stores them in the database (they survive restarts and override the config file and environment). settings maps dotted keys from get_config...

tools.name: get_licence
tools.title: Get the licence status
tools.summary: Returns the licence status of this server: status "valid" (full use), "grace" (the licence server is unreachable; renders keep working until graceUntil), "invalid" (renders and...

tools.name: activate_licence
tools.title: Set and activate the licence key (admin)
tools.summary: Stores the licence key (encrypted; needs REELFORGE_SECRET_KEY on the server) and activates it for this server with the licence server, then returns the status (see get_licence).

tools.name: deactivate_licence
tools.title: Give the licence activation back (admin)
tools.summary: Frees this server's activation of the licence key at the licence server, so the key can be activated on another server.

tools.name: get_storage
tools.title: Get storage driver, usage and health (admin)
tools.summary: Returns where asset and render files are stored: driver ("local", "s3", "azure", "gcs"), location (bucket/container, endpoint, prefix, credential source; never secrets), how dow...

tools.name: run_storage_cleanup
tools.title: Apply the storage retention policy now (admin)
tools.summary: Deletes renders the retention policy no longer keeps (older than storage.retention.renderDays; the newest keepLastRendersPerProject of each project and renders of running jobs a...

tools.name: list_keys
tools.title: List API keys (admin)
tools.summary: Lists API keys: id, name, scopes, prefix, status (active, expired, revoked), created, last used, expiry, limits, quotas, IP allowlist and, after a rotation, until when the old s...

tools.name: get_key
tools.title: Get an API key (admin)
tools.summary: One API key (as list_keys shows it) with its render usage today and this month (UTC).

tools.name: create_key
tools.title: Create an API key (admin)
tools.summary: Creates an API key with the given scopes (read, write, render, admin) and optional expiry, per-key rate limit, render quotas (per UTC day / month) and IP allowlist (CIDR).

tools.name: update_key
tools.title: Change an API key (admin)
tools.summary: Changes a key's name, expiry, rate limit, render quotas or IP allowlist (null clears one).

tools.name: rotate_key
tools.title: Rotate an API key (admin)
tools.summary: Gives a key a new secret (returned once) and keeps the old secret working for graceHours (default: the server setting keys.rotationGraceHours, 24 h), so clients can switch witho...

tools.name: revoke_key
tools.title: Revoke an API key (admin)
tools.summary: Revokes a key: it (and any old secret still in its rotation grace window) stops working at once.

tools.name: delete_key
tools.title: Delete an API key (admin)
tools.summary: Deletes an API key; it stops working immediately and disappears from list_keys (prefer revoke_key, which keeps it listed for the audit trail).

tools.name: list_audit_events
tools.title: Read the audit log (admin)
tools.summary: The audit trail, newest first: who (API key id and name), action (e.g. "key.rotate", "project.create", "config.update"), target, result (success, failure, denied), client IP, us...
